## Summary

Describe the design specification added or modified and the key visual characteristics.

## Checklist

- [ ] Frontmatter adheres to Google's DESIGN.md schema (`name`, `description`, `colors`, `typography`, `rounded`, `spacing`, `components`).
- [ ] Markdown body follows the 8 canonical sections in exact order (Overview, Colors, Typography, Layout, Elevation & depth, Shapes, Components, Do's and Don'ts).
- [ ] Free of project-specific noise, internal identifiers, and private datasets.
- [ ] Follows plain language style without em dashes or AI fluff words.
- [ ] Any required visual assets are committed under `designs/<name>/assets/`.
- [ ] Catalog table in `README.md` is updated.
